title: AI Displacement Risk Screener
description: Compute an automation-exposure score from embedded O*NET/Frey-Osborne task-composition data for any job title or SOC code. Returns a 0–100 risk score, risk tier, 3 adjacent lower-exposure occupations with salary delta, and a routing card to the right retraining path.

mcp_tool_definition.name: ai_displacement_risk_screener
mcp_tool_definition.description: Score a job's automation exposure (0–100) from embedded O*NET/Frey-Osborne data. Returns risk tier (Low/Medium/High/Critical), 3 adjacent lower-exposure occupations, and a retraining routing recommendation.
